name: minicut
description: Make AI short dramas from Codex: MiniCut writes the script, plans every shot, makes the video and edits the episode. Plus MiniAPI, one key for Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 and other video, image and voice models.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI short films and run video models from Codex
interface.longDescription: Make a multi-shot AI short film from an idea inside Codex. The minicut-film-studio skill installs the MiniCut CLI, which writes the story, plans every shot, makes character and location pictures, video takes, voice lines and music, and edits the cut, with a check after every step. The miniapi-video skill runs Seedance, Kling, Wan and other video, image and voice models on one MiniAPI key. Every paid job prints its price and waits for a yes.
